transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Before we close the curriculum agenda, I'd like to follow our usual practice. Could the department chair and the college liaison please report any remaining requirements for the environmental science dual-credit proposal we've received for next academic year?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to report a remaining requirement for this proposal. During my department staffing review this week, I confirmed that the proposed instructor does not hold the credential required to teach a dual-credit science course. Under district dual-credit rules, authorization is permitted only if a credentialed science co-teacher is assigned to every class meeting. I have not yet amended the proposal to reflect this requirement.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I also need to report a remaining requirement for this proposal. I verified the college's signed articulation agreement this week, and it classifies environmental science as a 3-credit course requiring 2 laboratory contact hours per week. The school's current proposal describes it as a 2-credit seminar with only 1 laboratory contact hour per week, so it does not match the articulation agreement. I have not yet updated the proposal to reflect the correct credit and lab hour requirements.
transcript.speaker: A3
